name: background-task-rows
opens_with: (/voice to clear the boot notice; rows come from the agent script)
assert_screen: contains:Index the vendored TUI design-system crates
notes: Docked bottom-left of the messages area, drawn after render_messages and before every overlay. The rows are DERIVED from operant_core's process-wide async_delegation registry, so the script seeds real records through the same public create_record/mark_completed the real delegate_task(background=true) path calls — nothing is injected into the TUI's own state. The leading /voice is load-bearing: voice_mode_notice is visible from frame 0 on a host with an audio device, and it ORs into any_modal_open. Two rows (one spawned, one done) plus the footer count is the at-capacity-adjacent case the rows_area clamp regression needs.
